gloss: to be caught, to hold on

forms.label: ている past polite
forms.negative: {捕|つか}まっていませんでした

definitions.gloss: to be caught, to be arrested
to hold on, to grab onto

examples.english: I was holding on to the strap on the train.

notes:
{捕|つか}まる has two main meanings: 'to be caught/arrested' and 'to hold onto something.'

TRANSITIVITY:
- Type: ⟦{自動詞|じどうし}→自動詞：10977_jidoushi⟧ (intransitive)
- Pair: ⟦{捕|つか}まえる→捕まえる：01214_tsukamaeru⟧ (transitive, to catch)

SENSE 1 - Be caught:
- ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{捕|つか}まる: a criminal is caught
- ⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{捕|つか}まる: to be caught by police
- ⟦タクシー→タクシー：00816_takushii⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧{捕|つか}まらない: can't catch a taxi

SENSE 2 - Hold onto:
- ⟦{手|て}すり→手すり：12754_tesuri⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{捕|つか}まる: to hold onto the handrail
- ⟦{吊|つ}り{革|かわ}→吊り革：08351_tsurikawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{捕|つか}まる: to hold onto the strap (on train)

WRITING:
{捕|つか}まる uses {捕|ほ} (capture). The related verb ⟦{掴|つか}む→掴む：02290_tsukamu⟧ (to grab) uses different kanji.

ASPECT (ている):
- Sense 1: {捕|つか}まって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = has been caught / is in custody (resultative state)
- Sense 2: {捕|つか}まって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = is holding on (ongoing state of grasping)
- Note: For sense 1, the て⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ form describes the ongoing state after being captured: ⟦{犯人|はんにん}→犯人：03572_hannin⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{警察|けいさつ}→警察：01393_keisatsu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{捕|つか}まって⟦いる→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'the criminal is in police custody.' For sense 2, it describes the ongoing action of holding on: ⟦{電車|でんしゃ}→電車：00522_densha⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{吊|つ}り{革|かわ}→吊り革：08351_tsurikawa⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{捕|つか}まって⟦いた→いる：00495_iru⟧ = 'I was holding on to the strap on the train.' Context disambiguates the two senses.
